title: Encode and compare protocol bytes
responsibility: Provide UTF-8, base64, hashing, random-byte and deterministic JSON helpers for the remote protocol.

inputs.name: cryptoSource.bytes
inputs.description: Byte array to expose to WebCrypto without copying.

inputs.name: bytesText.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to decode as strict UTF-8.

inputs.name: toBase64.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to encode as padded standard base64.

inputs.name: fromBase64.text
inputs.description: Strict standard base64 with valid padding and no whitespace.

inputs.name: toBase64Url.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to encode as unpadded URL-safe base64.

inputs.name: fromBase64Url.text
inputs.description: Unpadded URL-safe base64 text; a length congruent to one modulo four is rejected.

inputs.name: toHex.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes to encode as lowercase hexadecimal.

inputs.name: concatBytes.parts
inputs.description: Byte arrays to concatenate in argument order.

inputs.name: sha256.bytes
inputs.description: Bytes whose SHA-256 digest is requested.

inputs.name: randomBytes.length
inputs.description: Requested byte-array length, subject to typed-array and WebCrypto limits.

inputs.name: stableJson.value
inputs.description: JSON-like value to serialize with recursively sorted object keys.

outputs.name: cryptoSource
outputs.description: The same byte array with a WebCrypto-compatible type.

outputs.name: toHex
outputs.description: Two lowercase hexadecimal characters per byte.

outputs.name: concatBytes
outputs.description: New array containing all supplied parts in order.

outputs.name: randomBytes
outputs.description: New byte array filled with cryptographic random values.

outputs.name: safeEqual
outputs.description: True only for equal strings; unequal lengths return early, while equal lengths compare every character.

outputs.name: stableJson
outputs.description: JSON text with sorted object keys and undefined object properties omitted; unsupported primitive values become null.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects malformed encodings or UTF-8; invalid random lengths, unsupported JSON values such as BigInt, circular structures and WebCrypto failures may also throw.
